description: This file defines a comparator class for sorting LoanTermVariations objects based on their effective term application date and other criteria.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsComparator
classes.description: A comparator class that sorts LoanTermVariations instances based on term applicable date and term type conditions.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two LoanTermVariations objects to determine their order based on term applicable date, and for equal dates, based on term type conditions.
